summary: In MovieEditorViewModel.ShowProperties(), changed filePath: null to filePath: _originalMovie.CurrentFilePath so the MoviePropertiesViewModel receives the actual file path (populated by DapperMovieRepository.GetByIdAsync via the LEFT JOIN added in WP-010).
